subject: Hospitality
title: Destination Wedding Economics
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Destination Wedding Economics.

hook.text: A destination wedding in Bali costs the couple more but spends less per guest—because fewer people attend.

buildup.text: Average destination wedding: 50–80 guests vs. 130+ locally. Smaller lists mean higher per-person budgets and intimacy.

discovery.text: Hotels love destination weddings: guests book 3–5 night stays vs. one-night stays for local weddings.

twist.text: Destination weddings shift costs to guests: flights, accommodation, and time off work.

climax.text: Resorts now offer all-inclusive wedding packages: ceremony, reception, cake, photographer.

punchline.text: Fewer guests, longer stays, higher spending. Destination weddings are a hotel's dream.

quiz.question: Why do hotels prefer destination weddings over local weddings?
options: Guests book 3–5 night stays vs. one night—room revenue far exceeds local events
